text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On one particular day leading up to the Fan Fest…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A photo shoot?

text_block_list.name: Fan Fest Organizer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's the main event for the Fan Fest! We want you to make an appearance no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looks like some organizers are going around scouting Umamusume on campus.

text_block_list.name: Fan Fest Organizer
text_block_list.text: As the photo shoot operates on a rotational basis, we'll only need to borrow you for an hour. More importantly, you can greet your fans!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The organizer appears to be brimming with anticipation… But unfortunately, Agnes Tachyon dislikes, above all else, anything that she deems a waste of time.
choice_data_list: (I bet she's going to turn her down…)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A photo shoot, eh? How utterly fascinating! Why not? I accept your proposal!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What? What are you getting all surprised for?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Lo and behold, Agnes Tachyon chooses to participate in the photo shoot during the Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As soon as the event organizer leaves, I ask her out of curiosity why she agreed to the photo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Lately, I've become increasingly curious about the powers that stem from factors like "enthusiasm" and "passion."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's surprising that the science-loving Agnes Tachyon would show such interest over emotional things.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I simply sensed potential from my own firsthand observations.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The extent of muscular exertion depends on psychological as well as physiological factors. It has been proven that motor performance is linked to the level of activity in the cerebral cortex and the central nervous system!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: nervous system!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The effect that a crowd's cheering has on a person will depend on various psychological factors. In the case of adolescent human females, this relationship is proven to be statistically significant, but…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whether or not the same conclusion can be made about Umamusume… That is the aim of this study.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, in simpler terms, I plan on getting closer to my fans.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This is, of course, for the sake of my research.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's Agnes Tachyon for you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Fan Fest has come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A crowd of fans, enthralled by her appearance at the Osaka Hai, flock over to the photo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Your performance at the Osaka Hai was amazing! I'll be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, I appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I'm seeing you in person! You're the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The pleasure is all mine! Ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though I know it's for the sake of research, I stand dumbfounded by the unfamiliar sight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eventually, the photo shoot comes to a close.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Phew! That was somewhat exhausting!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I was able to gather plenty of observational data. Chances like these are so hard to come by.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A sharp increase in respiration and heart rate, dilated pupils… Each individual demonstrated all of these responses, albeit to varying degrees.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I believe they see me as some sort of reward. Heh, just fascinating. I wonder what else is in store.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes. Very good. My number of guinea pigs has increased. The fruit of one's labors, one could say!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As to how she manages to always keep so true to herself… it leaves me speechless.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Rest assured, you're still my number one guinea pig.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I realize she's saying this out of consideration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At any rate, the events of this Fan Fest seem to have stimulated her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… That was more tiring than I had thought!
choice_data_list: You seemed to have been enjoying yourself

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Did it seem that way? I guess I couldn't contain myself over the idea of finding more test subjects.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Besides, it's such a rare opportunity to be able to observe people eliciting such emotional responses up close!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Upon laying their eyes on me, their respiration and heart rates seemed to visibly fluctuate, evidencing stimulation to their dopamine nervous systems.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It would follow, then, that the more races I win, the more their reward systems are stimulated. At this rate, there might come a day where the simple sight of me provokes tears.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh… Dear me, how intriguing this concept of fandom is.
choice_data_list: …But how did you feel during the photo shoot?
…But how did you feel during the photo shoot?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I don't really imagine myself getting used to that sort of thing, but it wasn't nearly as bad as I imagined.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It was… in subjective terms, and in every sense of the word—bubbly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, in any case, it wasn't an unpleasant experience. If anything, it was on the pleasant side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though not in the way I imagined, it seems like she found her own way to enjoy the photo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She laughs abruptly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! I remember now! "And if you gaze long enough into an abyss, the abyss will gaze back into you," or so it goes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, this is purely speculative, however…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: There may come a day when I, too, could tear up at the mere sound of their cheers.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But if such a phenomenon directly correlates to an improvement in speed, then it is a price I'm willing to pay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It appears this Fan Fest has been extra stimulating for Agnes Tachyon.
